# Thermodynamics

`jaff.physics.Thermodynamics`

<!-- Generated by `python -m jaff._utils.api_docs`; do not edit. -->

Thermal state equations of a network: heating rates, EOS and `dT/dt`.

Bound to one `Network`; reachable as
`net.thermodynamics`. All attributes are built lazily and cached.

## Constructor

`#!python Thermodynamics(net, dEdt_extra=None)`

**Parameters**

**net** : _Network_
: Network whose reactions, symbols and EOS properties are used.

**dEdt_extra** : _sympy.Expr, optional_
: Stored volumetric non-reactive heating/cooling rate (e.g. restored from a
    `.jaff` file). When `None` it is built from the `heatingcoolingrate`
    auxiliary function.

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `eos` | `InternalEnergy` | Internal energy for the configured equation of state. |
| `dEdt_chemical, dEdt_extra, dEdt_tot` | `DEDt` | Chemical, non-reactive and total heating/cooling rates. |
| `dTdt_chemical, dTdt_extra, dTdt_tot` | `sympy.Expr` | Corresponding temperature rates [K s⁻¹]. |

## Properties

| Property | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`dEdt_chemical`](dEdt_chemical.md) | Chemical heating/cooling rate `Σ_r dE_r F_r` [erg cm⁻³ s⁻¹]. |
| [`dEdt_extra`](dEdt_extra.md) | Non-reactive heating/cooling rate (`heatingcoolingrate`) [erg cm⁻³ s⁻¹]. |
| [`dEdt_tot`](dEdt_tot.md) | Total heating/cooling rate, `dEdt_chemical + dEdt_extra`. |
| [`eos`](eos.md) | Internal energy of the network for its configured EOS (built once). |
| [`dTdt_chemical`](dTdt_chemical.md) | Temperature rate from the chemistry [K s⁻¹]. |
| [`dTdt_extra`](dTdt_extra.md) | Temperature rate from non-reactive heating/cooling [K s⁻¹]. |
| [`dTdt_tot`](dTdt_tot.md) | Total temperature rate `(Ė_tot − Σ_i ∂E/∂n_i · ṅ_i) / (∂E/∂T)` [K s⁻¹]. |
